policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O cuts GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna pricing; boosts API price-performance
items.summary: O stated it reduced GPT-5.6 Sol API/credit pricing by over 20% (3 months) and passed performance gains to customers via lower prices for GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra.

items.headline: G closes $350M Series A to scale inference cloud
items.summary: G announced a $350M Series A led by Disruptive, with planned NVIDIA participation, positioning the funding to expand an inference-focused cloud offering.

items.headline: O releases GPT-5.6 Sol update; expands GPT-5.6 Luna access for free users
items.summary: O announced improvements to GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT and expanded access to GPT-5.6 Luna for free users, while clarifying which Sol version powers Work/Codex.
